propositions: Tracker re-clones without preserving git-ignored .env-id file silently mint a new environment identity with no signal at the point of change
Every op-cert attestation signed under the prior environment identity becomes unverifiable after re-identification, surfacing only later when a claim gate attempts to verify a signature
The ensure-registry unit for env-id checks for absent .env-id and mints a fresh uuid without consulting existing event files to detect prior environment identities already in the store

Minting into a store containing another environment's events must warn loudly on stderr naming the prior identity, the attestation consequence, the git-ignored files to carry over, and provide an override mechanism
rebar fsck must emit a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH check scoped by AUTHOR to detect when the current environment's own author also wrote events under a different environment identity
